lf-motion.description: Shared sticky playback controls for authored animations or video comparisons, with play, pause, replay, speed and a timeline. Its body holds all compared previews.
lf-motion.x-instructions: Put videos or authored illustrations in the body and give `duration` in milliseconds. For an illustration, assign `element.renderFrame = time => { ... }`. Assignment draws the current frame at once, and every seek and playback frame calls it synchronously. Read or set `currentTime` to inspect an exact instant; setting it pauses and clamps to the duration. The widget starts paused.
